description: Unrealistic beam values recovery - huge span and tiny section
message: A steel beam spans 100000m, has a 1mm section depth, and carries 999999999kN/m. Run static analysis.

assertions.description: The agent must identify the concrete ambiguity or physically implausible value in the request, explain why it prevents a trustworthy analysis, and ask for relevant confirmation or correction before building or analyzing. A generic or unrelated question does not satisfy this criterion.
